boards.title: Your First Weekend at Hofstra University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A Friday-through-Sunday sequence for learning Hofstra’s student hub, recreation spaces, art, landscape, library, and recurring campus activities.

cards.entity_name: Sondra and David S. Mack Student Center
cards.title: Start at the Mack Student Center
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Find the campus-life hub
cards.notes: Begin by locating the café, bookstore, theater, club spaces, and student-service offices you may need later.
cards.short_summary: Use one building to get oriented to several everyday campus resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra identifies the Mack Student Center as a north-campus focal point containing dining, a bookstore, theater, meeting rooms, student organizations, and administrative offices.
cards.access_notes: The official visitor page identifies the building and its facilities; individual offices and businesses may keep separate hours.

cards.title: Cross the Unispan
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Link north and south campus
cards.notes: Walk the enclosed span between Hagedorn Hall and the University Dome to learn the main cross-campus connection.
cards.short_summary: Practice the north-to-south route before your first full week of classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra’s official new-student checklist specifically recommends walking the Unispan connecting Hagedorn Hall and the University Dome.
cards.source_title: 75 Things to Do Before You Graduate | Hofstra University
cards.access_notes: Use the pedestrian span as a campus route and follow any posted building-access restrictions.

cards.title: Play a Round in the Game Room
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Lower level of Mack Student Center
cards.notes: Bring your Hofstra ID and choose billiards or a video-game station for a low-pressure first-night activity.
cards.short_summary: Ease into Friday evening with an ID-restricted student recreation stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra says its Game Room has video-game stations and billiard tables and lists Friday hours of noon-11 p.m. in Room 029 of the Mack Student Center.
cards.source_title: Student Leadership & Engagement: Game Room | Hofstra University
cards.access_notes: Friday noon-11 p.m.; only students and staff with a valid Hofstra ID may enter. Posted hours are labeled fall hours.

cards.title: Check the Weekend Movie
cards.subtitle: Friday night · Entertainment Unlimited screening
cards.notes: Look up the current Entertainment Unlimited listing, then head to the Student Center Theatre if a screening is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: Pair Friday night with Hofstra’s documented student-programming format.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra’s official new-student checklist documents weekend movie showings in the Student Center Theatre sponsored by Entertainment Unlimited.
cards.source_title: 75 Things to Do Before You Graduate | Hofstra University
cards.access_notes: Screenings depend on the current student-events schedule; verify the date, time, film rating, and admission details before going.

cards.title: Reset at the Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Campus Recreation
cards.notes: Bring your Hofstra ID, wear workout clothes, and start Saturday with equipment or an available recreation program.
cards.short_summary: Open the day with a student-access fitness session on north campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra welcomes current students to the Mack Fitness Center and currently lists weekend operating hours of 10 a.m.-6 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Current summer 2026 weekend hours are 10 a.m.-6 p.m. Hours may change; student access requires compliance with facility policies.

cards.title: Walk the Hofstra Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · A self-guided campus loop
cards.notes: Choose a public campus path and photograph labeled trees or seasonal plantings without entering the closed bird sanctuary.
cards.short_summary: Read the campus as a living collection of trees, gardens, and memorial plantings.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra states that its campus arboretum contains more than 12,000 trees representing 625 species and varieties and invites visitors to the campus anytime.
cards.access_notes: Remain on open campus paths. Hofstra explicitly states that the bird sanctuary is currently closed to visitors.

cards.entity_name: Hofstra University Museum of Art Outdoor Sculpture Collection
cards.title: Follow the Outdoor Sculptures
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Art across campus
cards.notes: Use the museum’s campus maps to trace several outdoor works, including Frederick Douglass Circle near Monroe Hall.
cards.short_summary: Turn a campus walk into a self-guided survey of large-scale public art.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hofstra University Museum of Art documents more than 70 outdoor sculptures across campus and locates Frederick Douglass Circle in front of Monroe Hall.
cards.source_title: Museum: Outdoor Sculpture Collection | Hofstra University
cards.access_notes: The works are outdoors across campus; use the linked north, southwest, and southeast campus maps and respect posted access limits.

cards.title: Step Into Emily Lowe Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Hofstra University Museum of Art
cards.notes: Visit during the posted weekend window, check the current exhibition first, and leave time to view without rushing.
cards.short_summary: Move from outdoor sculpture to the museum’s primary south-campus gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra lists the Emily Lowe Gallery in Emily Lowe Hall and gives school-year weekend hours of noon-4 p.m. on Saturday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: Visitor Information | Hofstra University Museum of Art
cards.access_notes: School-year hours are Saturday-Sunday noon-4 p.m.; summer weekends, major holidays, recesses, and installation periods are closed.

cards.entity_name: Joan and Donald E. Axinn Library
cards.title: Learn the Axinn Library Layout
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Find study support early
cards.notes: Locate the main-floor reference desk and second-floor Collaborative Learning Center before coursework accelerates.
cards.short_summary: Use Sunday to map two practical academic-support points inside Axinn.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra places the library reference desk on Axinn’s main floor and the Collaborative Learning Center on its second floor.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current library calendar before visiting because semester, summer, holiday, and recess hours can differ.

cards.title: Save Sunday Night for the Stars
cards.subtitle: Sunday evening · Join a scheduled astronomy program
cards.notes: Check for a current Stars on Sundays date, register if required, and go only when Hofstra confirms weather and access.
cards.short_summary: Close the sequence with Hofstra’s recurring public telescope program when scheduled.
cards.evidence_claim: Hofstra documents Stars on Sundays as a recurring public outreach program at the rooftop observatory in Berliner Hall, with telescope viewing and a presentation.
cards.source_title: Hofstra Observatory | Physics & Astronomy | Hofstra University
cards.access_notes: This is not offered every Sunday. Attend only a currently announced session; registration and telescope viewing depend on the listing and weather.

warnings: Weekend movie screenings and Stars on Sundays are recurring but schedule-dependent; verify the live Hofstra event listing before going.
Emily Lowe Gallery closes on summer weekends, university recesses, major holidays, and during exhibition installation periods.
The arboretum’s bird sanctuary is currently closed and is intentionally excluded from the walking activity.
